crash_windows.recovery: resume from durable work checkpoint; never final-reply without END
search same delivery_key then send exactly one END if absent

crash_windows.window: after Gmail END send before durable receipt
crash_windows.recovery: search Gmail SENT by delivery_key/message_id; persist ACK; do not resend

crash_windows.window: scheduler says completed but Gmail END absent
crash_windows.recovery: set OPEN_DELIVERY_FAILURE; send END; scheduler status has zero authority
search SENT by delivery_key; if absent send standalone END; persist actual provider message_id

invariants: final ChatGPT closeout blocked until Gmail END provider ACK is durable
new work cannot reuse a CLOSED tranche
new work cannot silently overwrite an OPEN_DELIVERY_FAILURE tranche
a scheduler completion is never Gmail delivery proof
the user message is never a closeout trigger
END send is search-before-send and idempotent
provider message_id and SENT readback are authoritative delivery evidence
